description.p: An administrator facing analytics dashboard for a Nuxeo repository, served by the platform at /nuxeo/dashboard/ and reachable from the Web UI Administration menu.
Charts and figures are described by configuration rather than hard coded, and every widget on a page is batched into a single OpenSearch aggregation request.

Requires the OpenSearch search client with the passthrough enabled (nuxeo.passthrough.elasticsearch.enabled). The Governance dashboard additionally requires the nuxeo-retention addon, and the Workflows dashboard the audit passthrough (nuxeo.passthrough.elasticsearch.audit.enabled).
